author: hdprajwal
abstract: A decision chamber for high-stakes, ambiguous calls. Five specialist advisors (contrarian, first-principles, expansionist, outsider, executor) attack the framed question independently and blind to the conversation; the five proposals are anonymized and shuffled into a blind teardown round where one reviewer tries to destroy each without knowing who wrote it; a fresh, conversation-blind chairman then weighs what survived attack and returns a verdict, not a menu. Eleven subagents in total, with a reduced-chamber mode for lighter calls. Seeded by affaan-m/ECC's council skill, rebuilt into a three-stage advisor → blind-review → chairman pipeline.
